Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes — damaged items are handled differently. Regular returns/exchanges aren’t accepted because all items are final sale, but if something arrived damaged we handle that through our damage/defect process instead. If you want, tell me whether it was damaged in shipping or it’s a flaw with the product itself.
